title: Alter — Aperture, continued. Open source, for the Mac.
description: Alter opens your Aperture library exactly as you left it — projects, versions, ratings, keywords and adjustments — with Aperture’s tools and keyboard shortcuts. Its core is open source, so it can never be taken away. Free for macOS 13 or later.
finePrint: Free on the Mac App Store · Open-source core · macOS 13 or later · Apple Silicon & Intel
